BASES.TITLE: Bases
BASES.EMPTY: Add the databases this company uses in the Update Server.
BASES.DESCRIPTION: Databases this company uses in the Albatross Update Server.
BASES.SEARCH: Search by ID, name, database or document

HELP.albatross_id: The base ID in the Update Server. It cannot repeat inside this company.
HELP.display_code: Optional. The order shown in the Update Server list.
HELP.database_name: Exact database name, used to find the base.
HELP.link: Optional. Must start with http:// or https://.
HELP.documento: Optional. CPF or CNPJ of the base owner.

LICENSES.TITLE: Licenses
LICENSES.EMPTY: Add the users of this company and the modules each one uses.
LICENSES.DESCRIPTION: One license per user, with the modules that user has. The totals are summed automatically.
LICENSES.SEARCH: Search by user, code or type
LICENSES.DUPLICATE_USER: This user already has an active license in this company. You can still save.

HELP.code: The license code. Users with the same code are grouped.
HELP.license_type: The license type, as used in the spreadsheet.
HELP.modules: Pick at least one module. Only active licenses count in the totals.

BULK.TITLE: Add several users
BULK.DESCRIPTION: One user per line. The code, type and modules below apply to everyone.
BULK.PREVIEW: {count} license will be created | {count} licenses will be created
BULK.IGNORED: {count} repeated line ignored | {count} repeated lines ignored
BULK.EXISTING: {count} user already has an active license | {count} users already have an active license
BULK.FAILED_TITLE: These users were not created. They stay in the box so you can try again:

MODULES_PANEL.TITLE: License modules
MODULES_PANEL.DESCRIPTION: They apply to every company. A module that is no longer used is deactivated, not deleted, and still shows in the licenses that already use it.

SUMMARY.TITLE: Licenses in use
SUMMARY.FILTER_HINT: Click a module to filter the license list.

UPDATE_SERVER.NO_RESULTS: Nothing matches the search or the filters.
